notes: UK MNO lifecycle batch reverified for canonical migration: Three current 180-day rule + 15p SMS/£5 top-up; O2 Classic preserved HOLD as legacy-only; EE current 180/90/270 lifecycle + 20p SMS, physical PAYG SIM only.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current Three PAYG support requires at least one chargeable activity every 180 days. Buying a top-up/Data Pack/Add-on counts; calls, texts and data count only on Three mobile service, not Wi-Fi. Current standard SMS is 15p and current PAYG price guidance includes a £5 top-up. A PAYG SIM intended for use abroad must first be provisioned by a UK purchase/activation step.

keep.action: Before 180 days elapse, perform one qualifying chargeable activity. A standard UK SMS is currently £0.15; buying a top-up also resets the clock. Wi-Fi-only activity does not count. Once disconnected, the number cannot be reconnected.

routes.chinaActivation: Three requires a purchase associated with the SIM in the UK before using Three services abroad; PAYG eSIM is currently offered.
routes.payment: Three app/My3/web top-up by card; current top-up denominations include GBP5. International-card acceptance not independently reconciled.
routes.wifiCalling: unverified for the keep-alive event; Wi-Fi activity does not satisfy the 180-day rule.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad free (UK operator standard). Sending from China requires roaming — Three roaming add-on structure applies; receiving-only strategy viable.
routes.tariffSummary: 180-day chargeable-activity rule; 15p standard SMS; top-up credit available from £5; disconnected number cannot be restored.
guideSteps: Order the Three PAYG SIM/eSIM. If you plan to use it abroad, complete the required UK purchase/provisioning step first.
Keep some PAYG credit, then before 180 days elapse send one standard SMS on the mobile network (currently 15p), or perform another listed chargeable activity.
Do not rely on Wi-Fi-only activity; Three says it does not count, and a disconnected number cannot be restored.

routes.acquisitionSummary: NOT A GENERAL NEW-USER ROUTE. O2 currently labels Classic Pay As You Go an older/legacy tariff and says customers who are not already on it cannot switch to it. Existing Classic lines remain subject to the six-month activity rule and £10 minimum top-up.

keep.action: Legacy Classic holders: carry out a chargeable activity at least once in every 6-month period; the current Classic page lists a standard text at £0.02. The same page lists a GBP10 minimum top-up. This is retention guidance for existing holders, not a route for new users.

routes.chinaActivation: UK-network first activation standard; China-first unverified.
routes.wifiCalling: O2 Wi-Fi Calling PAYG support limited — 验证中.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad free. O2 PAYG roaming outside Europe limited — receiving-only strategy standard.
routes.holdReason: Classic Pay As You Go is a legacy tariff. O2 currently says customers who are not already on it cannot switch to it; keep this as negative/legacy-holder knowledge rather than a recommendation.
routes.tariffSummary: Legacy-only Classic PAYG: six-month activity rule, 2p text, GBP10 minimum top-up; not generally available to new users.
guideSteps: If you already hold Classic PAYG, perform a chargeable activity before six months elapse.
Do not buy or recommend this as a current new-user route; O2 marks Classic as an older legacy tariff and says non-holders cannot switch to it.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current EE PAYG support sends a warning around day 160, moves the account into hibernation at 180 days, allows a 90-day recovery window, and closes the account at 270 days. Qualifying activity includes calls, texts/picture messages, voicemail, mobile data, top-ups and plan/add-on purchases, in the UK or abroad. Current out-of-plan UK SMS price is 20p.

keep.action: Before 180 days elapse, perform any EE-listed usage action. A standard out-of-plan UK SMS is currently £0.20. If the line enters hibernation at day 180, call EE within the next 90 days to recover the number and credit; after day 270 the account is closed.

routes.chinaActivation: Current EE PAYG voice SIM acquisition is physical; China-first activation and long-term China OTP behavior remain unverified.
routes.payment: EE online/app/phone top-up accepts GBP5–95 in GBP5 increments and supports international credit/debit cards.
routes.roamingSms: PAYG can roam subject to destination rules; EE community/support evidence says receiving SMS is free while abroad. China OTP reliability remains unverified.
routes.tariffSummary: 160-day warning; 180-day hibernation; 90-day recovery; 270-day hard closure; current standard SMS 20p; minimum top-up £5; current EE PAYG voice SIM is physical.
guideSteps: Acquire a current EE PAYG physical SIM. Current direct 30-day plans start at GBP10; top-ups can be as low as GBP5.
Before 180 days elapse, perform one listed activity; a standard out-of-plan UK SMS is currently 20p.
If EE puts the line into hibernation, contact EE within the following 90 days; after day 270 the number and remaining credit are lost.
